items.name: theme
items.title: Balick Theme
items.description: The monochrome colour palette, radius and dark mode used by every Balick UI component and block.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite scrolling track for logos, testimonials or anything else.

items.name: blur-fade
items.title: Blur Fade
items.description: Reveal content with a soft blur and fade, on mount or when scrolled into view.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A button with a beam of light travelling around its border.

items.name: grid-pattern
items.title: Grid Pattern
items.description: A lightweight SVG grid background with optional highlighted cells.

items.name: dot-pattern
items.title: Dot Pattern
items.description: A grid of dots, with a few that glow in turn.

items.name: flickering-grid
items.title: Flickering Grid
items.description: A field of small squares that flicker at random, drawn on a canvas.

items.name: retro-grid
items.title: Retro Grid
items.description: A grid floor in perspective that slides toward the horizon.

items.name: ripple
items.title: Ripple
items.description: Concentric rings that breathe from the center, behind a logo or a button.

items.name: light-rays
items.title: Light Rays
items.description: Soft rays of light that fan down from the top and sway slowly.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Veils of light that drift slowly across the top of a section.

items.name: grain
items.title: Grain
items.description: A paper grain that gives flat surfaces some texture.

items.name: interactive-grid
items.title: Interactive Grid
items.description: A grid whose cells light up under the pointer and fade out behind it.

items.name: wave-lines
items.title: Wave Lines
items.description: Thin lines that ripple like silk and part around the pointer.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: Layout primitives shared by every block: Section, Container and SectionHeader.

items.name: social-icons
items.title: Social icons
items.description: Brand icons for social links (GitHub, LinkedIn, X, YouTube), which lucide-react no longer ships.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: A small live indicator with a pulsing halo, in four tones.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A single choice between a few options, with a pill that slides to the selected one.

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated Number
items.description: A number that rolls up or down to its new value when it changes.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Counts up to a number once, when it scrolls into view.

items.name: arrow-button
items.title: Arrow Button
items.description: A button or link whose arrow nudges forward on hover and focus.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copies a text to the clipboard; the icon turns into a check mark.

items.name: status-button
items.title: Status Button
items.description: A button that shows the progress of its action: idle, loading, success or error.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold Button
items.description: Hold to confirm, for actions that are hard to undo.

items.name: text-roll-button
items.title: Text Roll Button
items.description: On hover, the label rolls up and an identical copy takes its place.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: A button that leans a few pixels towards the pointer.

items.name: ripple-button
items.title: Ripple Button
items.description: A button that sends a soft ripple out from where it is pressed.

items.name: spotlight-button
items.title: Spotlight Button
items.description: A soft light follows the pointer inside the button.

items.name: expand-button
items.title: Expand Button
items.description: An icon button whose label slides out on hover and focus.

items.name: theme-toggle-button
items.title: Theme Toggle Button
items.description: Switches between light and dark; the sun grows into a moon.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word Rotate
items.description: Cycles through words in place, each one sliding up into view.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Reveals a line word by word, each part fading in from a light blur.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types phrases character by character, with a blinking caret.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Letters start scrambled and settle one after the other.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer Text
items.description: A light sweeps across the text, for work in progress.

items.name: highlight-text
items.title: Highlight Text
items.description: A marker stroke draws behind the words once they scroll into view.

items.name: underline-link
items.title: Underline Link
items.description: A link whose underline draws in on hover and focus.

items.name: expandable-text
items.title: Expandable Text
items.description: Long text clamped to a few lines, with a button that unfolds the rest.

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: Days, hours, minutes and seconds left until a date, each rolling to its new value.

items.name: navbar-01
items.title: Navbar with mobile menu
items.description: Sticky navigation bar that turns translucent on scroll, with an accessible mobile menu.

items.name: hero-01
items.title: Hero with product preview
items.description: Centred hero with announcement pill, animated headline, product preview and a scrolling logo cloud.

items.name: hero-02
items.title: Split hero with deploy terminal
items.description: Left-aligned hero with key figures and an animated deploy terminal. No logo strip, so it pairs with logos-01.

items.name: hero-03
items.title: Personal hero
items.description: Personal introduction with availability status, social links and a scrolling list of tools. Made for portfolios.

items.name: logos-01
items.title: Logo grid
items.description: Hairline grid of customer logos with a short introduction.

items.name: about-01
items.title: About with key figures
items.description: Two-column introduction with paragraphs, key figures and skills.

items.name: features-01
items.title: Bento features
items.description: Bento grid of four illustrated features, followed by a row of secondary features.

items.name: features-02
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: Six features in a hairline grid, with a left-aligned header.

items.name: integrations-01
items.title: Integrations grid
items.description: Twelve integrations in a hairline grid, next to a sticky header and a link to the full list.

items.name: projects-01
items.title: Project grid
items.description: Grid of projects with screenshots, summary, year and stack. Draws a placeholder when a project has no image.

items.name: testimonials-01
items.title: Testimonial wall
items.description: Masonry wall of customer quotes with names, roles and initials avatars.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Pricing with billing toggle
items.description: Three-tier pricing with an animated monthly / yearly toggle and a highlighted plan.

items.name: pricing-02
items.title: Single plan
items.description: One all-inclusive plan: what's included on one side, price and call to action on the other.

items.name: pricing-03
items.title: Plan comparison table
items.description: Accessible feature comparison across three plans, grouped by category, with the featured plan highlighted.

items.name: faq-01
items.title: FAQ with accordion
items.description: Two-column FAQ: sticky header with a contact link, and an accessible accordion built on native disclosure elements.

items.name: blog-01
items.title: Latest posts
items.description: Three recent articles with a cover, category, date, author and reading time.

items.name: newsletter-01
items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: Email signup card with a confirmation state; posts to a configurable endpoint.

items.name: cta-01
items.title: Inverted call to action
items.description: High-contrast call to action panel with a subtle grid and two actions.

items.name: contact-01
items.title: Contact with channels
items.description: Contact panel with a copyable email address and a list of channels.

items.name: contact-02
items.title: Contact form with details
items.description: Contact form with a confirmation state, next to email, phone, address and opening hours.

items.name: stats-01
items.title: Stats grid
items.description: Four key figures with short descriptions, in a hairline grid.

items.name: timeline-01
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Company story as a vertical timeline, with a sticky header.

items.name: services-01
items.title: Services list
items.description: Numbered list of services with a starting price, deliverables and a link.

items.name: steps-01
items.title: How it works steps
items.description: Four numbered steps joined by a connector, horizontal on desktop and vertical on mobile.

items.name: team-01
items.title: Team grid
items.description: Team members with an avatar, role, short bio and social links.

items.name: footer-01
items.title: Footer with newsletter
items.description: Multi-column footer with newsletter form, status indicator, social links and an oversized wordmark.

items.name: footer-02
items.title: Compact footer
items.description: Single-row footer with links and socials, and a legal line.
